open_questions: Orbit limits are my defaults, owner to confirm: YAW_MIN_DEG -45, YAW_MAX_DEG 45, PITCH_MIN_DEG 20 (above the plane), PITCH_MAX_DEG 80, start yaw 0 / pitch 45. Keep or change?
Orbit input is right-mouse drag plus arrow keys (my choice). OK, or different binding?

handoff: game/map.gd is now a Node3D. Planets are SphereMesh MeshInstance3D nodes (lit, with a DirectionalLight3D) on the same placeholder ring (LAYOUT_RADIUS 6.0 world units, PLANET_RADIUS 0.8). Names are billboarded Label3D nodes under each sphere. Background is black: WorldEnvironment BG_COLOR black plus RenderingServer default clear colour black. Camera orbits the focus point. Constants at top of map.gd: YAW_MIN_DEG -45, YAW_MAX_DEG 45, PITCH_MIN_DEG 20, PITCH_MAX_DEG 80, START_PITCH_DEG 45, ORBIT_MOUSE_SENS 0.3, ORBIT_KEY_SPEED 60. Controls: WASD pans on the plane relative to view yaw, wheel zooms (ZOOM_MIN/ZOOM_MAX unchanged), right-drag or arrow keys orbit, Space pauses. main.gd, main.tscn, data/ untouched. Headless run: no script errors, only sandbox log-file and CA messages. Not verified visually: headless cannot render, so label size/readability, lighting, and orbit direction feel are untested.
